caption:
Lulu loves long weekend rides on her motorbike, but every time she gets off, her neck, wrists and hips ache.

Gripping the bars hard and holding one position for hours can tire your neck and wrists. A relaxed grip and regular breaks may share the load.

Hybi's tip: at every fuel stop, do 5 chin tucks, stretch your wrists for 10 seconds each way and hold a lunge-stance hip stretch for 20 seconds. Set your levers and bars so your hands feel relaxed.

Tingling fingers or neck pain spreading into your arm are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏍️
